source: The preset for Ruby on Rails. It reads config/locales YAML files with their top-level locale key, t and I18n.t calls, and lazy lookups.
text: O preset para Ruby on Rails. Ele lê arquivos YAML de config/locales com sua chave de idioma de nível superior, chamadas a t e I18n.t, e lazy lookups.
